| workflow | `src/effective_scale/core/workflow.py` | DAG state machines, attempts, retries, timeouts, cancel, cron, DLQ |

| capability | `saf/core/{compiler,resolver}.py, saf/runtime/executor.py` | Intent compilation, capability resolution, resources, execution lifecycle |
| observability | `src/effective_scale/observability/registry.py, saf/runtime/stats.py` | Structured logs, metrics, trace ids, audit trail |
| operations | `deploy/{systemd,windows,k8s} + Dockerfile/docker-compose.yml` | supervision, restart policy, health probes and longevity; restart-safety is a kernel property (K22), enforced by the supervisor contract (C-ops) |

## Invariants

| # | Invariant | Enforced by | Tested by |
|---|---|---|---|
| K1 | every mutation goes through the single writer (kernel.write / writer thread) | `src/effective_scale/core/kernel.py` | `tests/test_chaos.py` |
| K2 | readers only ever observe complete snapshots (atomic swap, never a torn mutation) | `src/effective_scale/ports/store.py` | `tests/test_chaos.py` |
| K3 | state transitions are table-checked; illegal jumps raise | `src/effective_scale/domain/states.py` | `tests/test_workflow.py` |
| K4 | a lease-bound attempt has at most one live owner (claim binds holder + fencing nonce) | `src/effective_scale/core/workflow.py` | `tests/test_workers.py` |
| K5 | completion is idempotent; fenced or stale completions never mutate state | `src/effective_scale/core/workflow.py` | `tests/test_workers.py` |
| K6 | replayed POSTs with an Idempotency-Key return the original response and apply once | `src/effective_scale/api/server.py` | `tests/test_api.py` |
| K7 | namespace isolation: an entity outside the caller's namespace is not found (404), never leaked | `src/effective_scale/api/server.py` | `tests/test_workers.py` |
| K8 | inputs and results are size-bounded (body limit, attempt result cap) | `src/effective_scale/api/server.py` | `tests/test_workers.py` |
| K9 | event lag is bounded: producers get backpressure instead of unbounded memory | `src/effective_scale/core/events.py` | `tests/test_events.py` |
| K10 | lease-bound attempts cannot be completed after their slot expires; the node retries | `src/effective_scale/core/workflow.py` | `tests/test_workers.py` |
| K11 | expired lease slots are reclaimed so capacity accounting stays honest | `src/effective_scale/core/kernel.py` | `tests/test_workers.py` |
| K12 | destructive intent at executing autonomy (A3+) is refused before any execution | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/saf/core/policy.py` | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/tests/test_executor.py` |
| K13 | a mutation is only 'verified' when disk state matches an expected hash or demonstrably changed (claims are not evidence) | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/saf/evidence/verification.py` | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/tests/test_executor.py` |
| K14 | the evidence log is append-only and hash-chained; verification detects tampering | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/saf/evidence/ledger.py` | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/tests/test_durability.py` |
| K15 | durable JSONL state survives torn writes (quarantine) and concurrent appends (file lock + fsync) | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/saf/core/durability.py` | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/tests/test_durability.py` |
| K16 | capability resolution is deterministic: same registry state, same ranking | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/saf/core/resolver.py` | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/tests/test_core.py` |
| K17 | a runtime exception never escapes the executor; it becomes a structured step result | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/saf/runtime/executor.py` | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/tests/test_executor.py` |
| K18 | offline submissions are durable and replayed idempotently (payload hash as idempotency key) | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/saf/transport/outbox.py` | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/tests/test_outbox.py` |
| K19 | a worker cannot outlive its lease silently: it heartbeats and reports deadline_exceeded instead of a late success | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/saf/runtime/worker.py` | `sovereign-agent-fabric-v20/tests/test_worker.py` |
| K20 | the reference kernel has zero third-party runtime dependencies | `ontology/system.json#claims.C-stdlib` | `tests/test_audit.py` |
| K21 | readiness reflects the ability to commit: /v1/health/ready is 503 whenever the kernel cannot execute a store statement or its writer is wedged, while /v1/health/live stays 200 because the process is still recoverable | `src/effective_scale/api/server.py` | `tests/test_cli.py` |
| K22 | sustained operation keeps every background loop alive with bounded durable state, and an abrupt restart resumes work without duplicating attempts | `src/effective_scale/core/kernel.py` | `tests/test_soak.py` |
| K23 | placement never overcommits a node: CPU and memory are each compared against their own used totals, and a node is skipped as soon as either budget is exhausted for a workload | `src/effective_scale/core/scheduler.py` | `tests/test_scheduler.py` |
| K24 | client-driven writes are bounded: a saturated writer backlog or a breaker opened by repeated infrastructure failures returns 503 overloaded (shedding load, never buffering it), while loops and the readiness probe bypass both guards because they are the recovery path | `src/effective_scale/core/kernel.py` | `tests/test_writer_isolation.py` |
